variant_decisions.evidence: ASV main text reads 'David said to Solomon his son' — 'his son' renders the ketiv בנו (3ms suffix), not the qere בְּנִי 'my son', which would place 'My son' inside the quoted speech. The ASV note 'According to another reading, My son, as for me etc.' confirms the qere is the reading the ASV did not follow; the decision rests on the main-text wording.
